The '''Mantaris Manufacturing Plant #3''' was a factory in which the [[Gungan]]s constructed [[Mantaris-class amphibious medium transport|''Mantaris''-class transports]],<ref name="YC">''[[Star Wars: Yoda's Challenge Activity Center]]''</ref> a model of amphibious [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designed and manufactured jointly by [[Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps/Legends|Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps]] and [[Otoh Gunga Bongameken Cooperative/Legends|Otoh Gunga Bongowerks]].<ref name="WoTC">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20010222a&c=rpg|text=The ER-1 Probe Droid: More Secrets of Naboo}}</ref>
